name: Southern Star Tri-State Energy Corridor
monitor_reason: length: no sourced length, diameter or capacity; only a non-binding solicitation of interest (Oct 13 to Nov 14, 2025). Sponsor (Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline) and region are identified.
researcher_notes: Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline posted a non-binding solicitation of interest from October 13 to November 14, 2025 for a proposed expansion to carry gas across northeast Oklahoma, southeast Kansas and the southwest Missouri corridor. The page names no length, diameter, capacity, cost or in-service date. A web search found no other source. Not matched to an existing row: the existing Southern Star rows (P0253 system, P2564 Midwest Market Access, P7826 Cedar Vale compressor) are different projects, and P2628 is the short Tri-State Corridor Pipeline. The length rule cannot be met, so it stays on watch. Look for a binding open season, a FERC pre-filing or an EIA project listing. If it is later filed, stage it as an expansion row under PipelineName Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline.
